stages.name: sink-screen
stages.instruction: Screen each file for real security bugs (injection, path traversal, auth bypass, SSRF, unsafe deserialization). Return ONLY a JSON array of objects: [{"id": "<file>:<symbol>", "file": "...", "severity": "HIGH|MED|LOW", "score": 0.0-1.0, "summary": "...", "evidence": "..."}]. Omit speculative or intended behaviors.

stages.name: deep-audit
stages.prompt_template: Verify whether candidate `{id}` in `{file}` ({summary}) is genuinely reachable and exploitable across callers. Cite exact line numbers and return JSON: {{"id": "{id}", "confirmed": true/false, "poc_outline": "...", "fix": "..."}}.
